text:
Maya: Heads-up — noticed sustained burn on the gpu-node-saturation SLO in eu-west-1 over the last ~6h, current burn-rate ~3.8x. Prometheus firing a bunch of alerts, looks noisy (pod churn/evictions). Thinking we should tune alert for sustained signal and add per-region burn breakdown before paging oncall. Any quick thoughts?

Brian: Can you paste the PromQL and the exact numbers you saw?

Maya: Sure — here's what I'm querying live:
```
# rough SLI: fraction of time GPUs are under target utilization (invert of saturation)
sum(rate(gpu_core_used_seconds_total[5m])) / sum(machine_gpu_capacity)
```
Burn calc: SLO = 99.9% (monthly), error_budget = 0.1%. Over 1h window we exceeded allowed errors by ~3.8x (so burn-rate ~3.8). The alert that keeps firing is `GPU_SATURATION_HIGH` (firing groups in eu-west-1).

Elena: Ugh yeah we've seen that pattern before. Our current rule has no `for:` and triggers on 2m spikes from kubelet evictions. My suggestion: require sustained condition `for: 15m` and add `increase(eviction_count[15m]) < 1` as an exclusion to reduce churn noise. Also surface per-zone burn-rate in the SLO dashboard.

Kevin: Agree. Also add an annotation in Grafana to show recent autoscaler activity + deploys. If autoscaler scaled up then the saturation alert is probably transient. We should show both `saturation` SLI (gpu capacity percent available) and `latency` SLI separately so we don't conflate them.

ops-bot: Alert: GPU_SATURATION_HIGH (eu-west-1) — fired 12 times in last 4h.

Maya: Proposed quick changes:
- Alert rule: add `for: 15m` and require `count_over_time((gpu_saturated == 1)[15m]) > 3` to avoid single spikes.
- Exclude alerts that correlate with `kube_pod_eviction_total` increases.
- Add per-region burn-rate panels to Grafana and automated weekly error-budget slack summary.
- Short-term: silence non-actionable alerts for eu-west-1 under severity=low while we roll changes.

Brian: Sounds reasonable. Important to keep paging threshold at burn-rate > 2 for 30m (we've used that historically). If we change the alert `for:` we should ensure the oncall-runbook expectation matches. I'll draft the PR for alert-rule + grafana panel and tag @oncall in the PR description.

Elena: One more: let's export the burn-rate as a derived metric so we can do `max_over_time(burn_rate[1h])` in dashboards. That helps detect sustained bursts versus noisy short spikes. Also set alert severity to `page` only when burn_rate > 3 for 30m and error_budget_remaining < 10%.

Maya: Good call. I can add a derived recording rule: `record: slo:burn_rate:1h` with expression from the error budget window. Will include annotations about remediation and rollback plan.

Kevin: I'll update the Grafana dashboard; will add panels: per-region burn_rate, recent eviction rate, autoscaler events overlay. Will also add an alert summary panel for last 24h counts.

Maya: Cool. Action items: Brian to open PR with alert+recording-rule edits, Kevin updates dashboard, Elena to update runbook thresholds, I'll coordinate a short silence and test in staging then promote to prod. If anything pages unexpectedly during rollout we rollback within 10m.

Brian: PR incoming in ~30m. Tagging follow-ups: @Maya @Elena @Kevin. :thumbsup:

Elena: Recommend we also add a Grafana annotation when we change rules so we can correlate post-change.

Maya: Will do. Thanks all — closing the loop after PR lands. :eyes:
